assessment.why: Among L6 checkpoints, step 40 balances 80% length adherence, 2/30 medium-long shortfalls, 85.7% first-50-word lexical topic contact, and more line-broken passages than step 35. It still has clear prompt failures and generic/prose drift.
assessment.length_fix_vs_writing: Down-weighting terminal EOS postpones, but does not prevent, short-output collapse. Longer completions include useful local imagery and also wandering prose; writing quality is not a clear improvement over L4 or L1.
